This cafe was brought to me by an acquaintance whose lives in Itaewon. When I first heard the name, I asked, “When you say orangutan, Orang?”, but the actual cafe mascot was an orangutan.

This place is located inside Sinheung Market, located on the hill of Haebangchon, and its unique interior, which combines various emotions, caught my eye. As soon as I entered the store, the first thing that caught my eye was the ‘La Marzocco Linea’ espresso machine. Actually, I don't know much about coffee, but one of my acquaintances sang about how he really wanted to buy this machine (maybe it will be possible in the next life), so this brand was imprinted in my mind.

You have to climb quite a hill to get to Shinheung Market, and the stairs leading to the second and third floors inside the cafe are also quite steep. Do you think women wearing heels will have a hard time? I thought the 3rd floor was a space for outsiders, but I found out later that there is a separate rooftop. I plan on going later in the spring or summer when the weather warms up. Overall cozy and vintage atmosphere.

While wondering what to drink, I ordered a flat white. I don't really like acidic coffee, but fortunately it was strong and moderately bitter, so I was satisfied. It tasted similar to the one I had at Bonanza Coffee in Berlin before, and they used the same espresso machine there. Well, I don’t know why that’s the case. Next time I visit, I want to order and try drip coffee.

Cessler Coffee I discovered while visiting Haebangchon✨

I usually love desserts, so it was nice to see a variety of desserts as soon as I walked in. Homemade crumbles and tiramisu are signature desserts, and the owner said they are all made by himself.

I ordered Sunny Crumble Citrus flavor, C Latte, and Mistachio, and they were all so delicious☺️ The C Latte had a luxurious, sweet coffee flavor that wasn't overly sweet, and the Mistachio had a harmonious taste with a subtle mix of pistachio and matcha. Sunny Crumble is a savory crumble topped with sweet citrus, and it was delicious because you could taste both the savory and sweet flavors. Overall, both the drink and dessert were not overly sweet and had a harmonious taste.👍👍

The atmosphere was like that of Haebangchon, a hip old neighborhood, and they only played songs that suited the cafe atmosphere, so the atmosphere was great. It is divided into a first floor and a basement level, with the first floor being a conversation space and the basement floor being a quiet space. There weren't many tables, but the space between tables was wide, so it didn't feel stuffy at all. There are also seats outside on the first floor, so when the weather is nice, it would be nice to sit outside while looking around Haebangchon☀️

It's hard to get to Haebangchon because it's all hills, but Csler Coffee is close to the bus stop, so it's easy to find. Take bus number 405 and get off at Yongsan 2-ga-dong Community Center and walk for about 3 minutes. I think it’s a good location to see and visit Namsan🚌

A hip cafe great for conversation in Haebangchon, recommended to those looking for homemade desserts and special drinks🍀

reviews.text:
I moved next to the 108 stairs in Huam-dong... It got further away... I took the bus there.
The small space with its impressive yellow door matches well with the alley atmosphere.
When you open the door and enter, there are wooden tables, chairs, and fresh flowers, making it feel fresh and warm. Thanks to the purple flowers placed on the table, the space has a cozy, simple, but sincere atmosphere.

☕ Tall Whiz personally selects and roasts the coffee beans, so the coffee aroma is different.
The Aah I drank has a refreshing acidity and a clean finish. Kenya's unique bright fruity scent is present, but it's not too overpowering.

🍊 Homemade citron and quince syrup
On one side, citron and quince syrup made with organic sugar are carefully prepared. It is good because it is not artificially sweet but has a deep and subtle sweetness.  When the weather gets a little hot, you should drink some cool yuzu ice cream.

📚 A cup of coffee becomes more special thanks to Mr. Sajing, who calmly explained not only the story of coffee, but also the origin of the coffee beans and the roasting method.

If you fancy a cup of coffee near the 108 stairs in Huam-dong, I recommend Tall Whiz ✨

reviews.text:
I found a truly gem-like Roastery Cafe near Hyochang Park! This is TOLSWIZ. It is located in a quiet residential area and has a cozy hideout feel. Above all, the taste of coffee is truly excellent.
The owner is very proud of his coffee, and he says he personally handpicks high-quality single-origin coffee beans from Ethiopia, Colombia, Kenya, and Brazil, and uses only the best coffee beans. Since they never use spoiled coffee beans and even roast them directly in the store, the coffee taste is bound to be fresh and deep. If you are looking for a place in Hyochang Park that is serious about coffee, it is definitely TOLSWIZ.
I tried the premium vanilla gelato here, and while it was great on its own, the flavor when made into an affogato was truly fantastic! It was a truly special experience, especially with a light sprinkle of free organic sugar, which added sweetness along with a crunchy texture.
TOLSWIZ has a quiet and comfortable atmosphere, making it the perfect space to spend time alone or read a book. If you want to experience delicious specialty coffee and special handmade gelato at Hyochang Park, I highly recommend TOLSWIZ! The store also sells high-quality coffee beans, so a big advantage is that you can enjoy this delicious coffee at home.

reviews.text:
The time we arrived at the place at the end of Haebangchon was around 7:30. There were about 4 tables, but all of them were occupied. The location wasn't that great and there weren't many other options nearby, so it seemed difficult to come without making a reservation. It was small, cozy, and clean, and the atmosphere itself was nice.

Briefly look back on the food and drink you ate and drank in the order you ate them.


- Yunjudang Blending (Baekju): This is a house makgeolli that is a blend of several types of rice wine. It is a sweet and sour rice wine that is easy to drink. The various flavors seem to be well balanced.
- Andong Jinmaek Soju: It is written that it is made from whole wheat, but perhaps because of that, the soju has a slightly rough feeling rather than smooth. It had a bit of a whiskey feel to it, but I think it would be delicious if you prefer a strong peat flavor.
- Jindo Hongju: It was a distilled liquor that literally had a strong red color and tasted like it was made from ginseng or bellflower root. Anyway, it literally feels like a ‘medicinal’ drink, so I think I should drink it with samgyetang.
- Yunjudang Blending (Hondonju): This is a bomb liquor from Joseon that is a blend of white liquor and traditional soju. I asked about the red color and was told that it was a blend of Jindo Hongju.
Bottteul Takju: This is one of my personal favorite Takju. It has a moderately rich, sweet and sour taste, and it feels like eating yogurt.
- Overall review of alcohol: Compared to other traditional liquor restaurants, it cannot be said that there are many types of alcohol, but more is not necessarily better. You may have carefully selected alcohol that you think is really delicious, but if you are not a person who likes all alcohol, you may think there are few options. However, I like Takju, but I prefer distilled liquor, so it was a bit disappointing that there were fewer options compared to Takju or Cheongju.
.

- Jeju Makchang Sundae: One of my personal favorite foods is sundae. It seemed to have a bit of a pork smell and I wish the makchang had been a little firmer, but it didn't bother me too much. It goes very well with makgeolli.
- Grandmother's Zucchini Stew: It was literally a zucchini stew that tasted like it was cooked at home. The spicy flavor is impressive, and there is a lot of zucchini in it. Thanks to that, I ordered soju.
- Cheese Sweet Potato Pancake: Let’s order it first. You are free to add white truffle oil, and although it is not necessary, it is a good idea to order potato pancakes first.
- Overall food review: It's difficult to say that the food is very delicious, but overall, there are a variety of foods that go well with traditional alcohol, so you won't fail no matter what you choose. Personally, I liked other foods better than soup. It would be better to come for the second time rather than the first time and try a variety of drinks.
.
By the time I finished drinking and leaving, there was a drink being made in a corner. I thought I saw that he was taking a class on making alcohol, and it seemed like he often made alcohol like this. I wanted to ask about this and that, but there were other people in the group and I didn't want to disturb anything, so I left. Next time I get a chance, I want to come back to make alcohol and taste it.
